CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP VIEW _hsa_raw AS SELECT event_time,event_type,product_id,user_id,category_id FROM heldout_raw_events WHERE event_time>=TIMESTAMP '2019-10-01 00:00:00' AND event_time<TIMESTAMP '2019-10-25 00:00:00'

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE _hsa_q AS WITH eligible AS( SELECT user_id,sum(CASE WHEN event_time>=? AND event_type IN('view','cart','purchase') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::BIGINT eligibility_events, count(*)::BIGINT history_events_7d,count(DISTINCT product_id)::BIGINT history_distinct_items_7d, count(DISTINCT event_time::DATE)::BIGINT history_active_days_7d,max(event_time) last_history_time FROM _hsa_raw WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL AND event_time>=? GROUP BY user_id HAVING eligibility_events>0), picked AS(SELECT *,row_number() OVER(ORDER BY sha256(?||user_id::VARCHAR),user_id) sample_rank FROM eligible) SELECT sha256(?||user_id::VARCHAR) query_id,user_id,?::TIMESTAMP anchor,eligibility_events,history_events_7d, history_distinct_items_7d,history_active_days_7d,last_history_time,?::DOUBLE history_coverage_7d,?::BOOLEAN label_is_mature FROM picked WHERE sample_rank<=2000

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE _hsa_pop AS SELECT product_id,count(DISTINCT user_id)::BIGINT popularity_distinct_users FROM _hsa_raw WHERE event_time>=? AND event_type='purchase' AND product_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_id
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE _hsa_top AS SELECT *,row_number() OVER(ORDER BY popularity_distinct_users DESC,product_id) popular_source_rank FROM _hsa_pop QUALIFY popular_source_rank<=200

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE _hsa_recent_all AS SELECT q.query_id,e.product_id,max(e.event_time) last_user_event_time FROM _hsa_q q JOIN _hsa_raw e USING(user_id) WHERE e.event_time>=? AND e.product_id IS NOT NULL AND e.event_type IN('view','cart','purchase') GROUP BY q.query_id,e.product_id

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE _hsa_recent AS SELECT *,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY query_id ORDER BY last_user_event_time DESC,product_id) recent_source_rank FROM _hsa_recent_all QUALIFY recent_source_rank<=20

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE _hsa_c AS WITH k AS( SELECT q.query_id,p.product_id FROM _hsa_q q CROSS JOIN _hsa_top p UNION SELECT query_id,product_id FROM _hsa_recent) SELECT k.query_id,k.product_id,p.product_id IS NOT NULL from_popular,r.product_id IS NOT NULL from_recent, coalesce(g.popularity_distinct_users,0)::BIGINT popularity_distinct_users,p.popular_source_rank,r.recent_source_rank,r.last_user_event_time FROM k LEFT JOIN _hsa_top p USING(product_id) LEFT JOIN _hsa_recent r USING(query_id,product_id) LEFT JOIN _hsa_pop g USING(product_id)
SELECT count(*) FROM _hsa_c c WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _hsa_raw e WHERE e.product_id=c.product_id)
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP VIEW _hsa_t AS SELECT c.query_id,c.product_id,q.user_id,q.anchor FROM _hsa_c c JOIN _hsa_q q USING(query_id)
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE _hsa_du AS SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM _hsa_q
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE _hsa_di AS SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM _hsa_t
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE _hsa_dp AS SELECT DISTINCT user_id,product_id FROM _hsa_t

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE _hsa_i AS SELECT d.product_id,min(e.event_time) first_seen,max(e.event_time) last_seen FROM _hsa_di d LEFT JOIN _hsa_raw e USING(product_id) GROUP BY d.product_id

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE _hsa_category AS SELECT i.product_id, CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT e.category_id)=1 AND count(*) FILTER(WHERE e.event_time IS NOT NULL AND e.category_id IS NULL)=0 THEN min(e.category_id) END candidate_category_id, (count(DISTINCT e.category_id)>1 OR(count(DISTINCT e.category_id)>0 AND count(*) FILTER(WHERE e.event_time IS NOT NULL AND e.category_id IS NULL)>0)) candidate_category_ambiguous FROM _hsa_i i LEFT JOIN _hsa_raw e ON e.product_id=i.product_id AND e.event_time=i.last_seen GROUP BY i.product_id
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE _hsa_u AS SELECT d.user_id,min(e.event_time) first_seen FROM _hsa_du d LEFT JOIN _hsa_raw e USING(user_id) GROUP BY d.user_id

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE _hsa_meta AS SELECT p.*,c.candidate_category_id,c.candidate_category_ambiguous, c.candidate_category_id IS NULL candidate_category_missing,i.first_seen IS NOT NULL item_has_observed_history,u.first_seen IS NOT NULL user_has_observed_history, date_diff('microsecond',i.first_seen,?::TIMESTAMP)::DOUBLE/1000000 item_observed_age_seconds, date_diff('microsecond',u.first_seen,?::TIMESTAMP)::DOUBLE/1000000 user_observed_age_seconds, ?::DOUBLE source_coverage_24h,?::DOUBLE source_coverage_168h FROM _hsa_t p JOIN _hsa_i i USING(product_id) JOIN _hsa_category c USING(product_id) JOIN _hsa_u u USING(user_id)

SELECT count(*) FROM "actual_base_features" a JOIN "_hsa_meta" e USING(query_id,product_id) WHERE (a."candidate_category_id" IS DISTINCT FROM e."candidate_category_id") OR (a."candidate_category_ambiguous" IS DISTINCT FROM e."candidate_category_ambiguous") OR (a."candidate_category_missing" IS DISTINCT FROM e."candidate_category_missing") OR (a."item_has_observed_history" IS DISTINCT FROM e."item_has_observed_history") OR (a."user_has_observed_history" IS DISTINCT FROM e."user_has_observed_history") OR ((a."item_observed_age_seconds" IS NULL) IS DISTINCT FROM (e."item_observed_age_seconds" IS NULL) OR (a."item_observed_age_seconds" IS NOT NULL AND(NOT isfinite(a."item_observed_age_seconds") OR abs(a."item_observed_age_seconds"-e."item_observed_age_seconds")>greatest(1e-12,abs(e."item_observed_age_seconds")*1e-12)))) OR ((a."user_observed_age_seconds" IS NULL) IS DISTINCT FROM (e."user_observed_age_seconds" IS NULL) OR (a."user_observed_age_seconds" IS NOT NULL AND(NOT isfinite(a."user_observed_age_seconds") OR abs(a."user_observed_age_seconds"-e."user_observed_age_seconds")>greatest(1e-12,abs(e."user_observed_age_seconds")*1e-12)))) OR ((a."source_coverage_24h" IS NULL) IS DISTINCT FROM (e."source_coverage_24h" IS NULL) OR (a."source_coverage_24h" IS NOT NULL AND(NOT isfinite(a."source_coverage_24h") OR abs(a."source_coverage_24h"-e."source_coverage_24h")>greatest(1e-12,abs(e."source_coverage_24h")*1e-12)))) OR ((a."source_coverage_168h" IS NULL) IS DISTINCT FROM (e."source_coverage_168h" IS NULL) OR (a."source_coverage_168h" IS NOT NULL AND(NOT isfinite(a."source_coverage_168h") OR abs(a."source_coverage_168h"-e."source_coverage_168h")>greatest(1e-12,abs(e."source_coverage_168h")*1e-12))))

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE _hsa_values AS SELECT d.product_id,count(DISTINCT e.user_id) FILTER(WHERE e.event_type='view' AND e.event_time>=?)::BIGINT "auto_item_view_count_distinct_24h_user_id",count(DISTINCT e.user_id) FILTER(WHERE e.event_type='cart' AND e.event_time>=?)::BIGINT "auto_item_cart_count_distinct_168h_user_id",count(DISTINCT e.user_id) FILTER(WHERE e.event_type='purchase' AND e.event_time>=?)::BIGINT "auto_item_purchase_count_distinct_24h_user_id" FROM _hsa_di d LEFT JOIN _hsa_raw e ON e.product_id=d.product_id AND e.event_time>=? GROUP BY d.product_id

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP VIEW _hsa_extra AS SELECT p.query_id,p.product_id,v."auto_item_view_count_distinct_24h_user_id",v."auto_item_cart_count_distinct_168h_user_id",v."auto_item_purchase_count_distinct_24h_user_id" FROM _hsa_t p JOIN _hsa_values v USING(product_id)

SELECT count(*) FROM "actual_extra_features" a JOIN "_hsa_extra" e USING(query_id,product_id) WHERE (a."auto_item_view_count_distinct_24h_user_id" IS DISTINCT FROM e."auto_item_view_count_distinct_24h_user_id") OR (a."auto_item_cart_count_distinct_168h_user_id" IS DISTINCT FROM e."auto_item_cart_count_distinct_168h_user_id") OR (a."auto_item_purchase_count_distinct_24h_user_id" IS DISTINCT FROM e."auto_item_purchase_count_distinct_24h_user_id")

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE _hsa_support AS SELECT p.query_id,p.product_id, coalesce(bool_or(e.event_type='view' AND e.event_time>=?),false) pair_view_support, coalesce(bool_or(e.event_type='purchase' AND e.event_time>=?),false) past_pair_purchase_support, max(e.event_time) FILTER(WHERE e.event_type='view') last_pair_view,max(e.event_time) FILTER(WHERE e.event_type='purchase') last_pair_purchase FROM _hsa_t p LEFT JOIN _hsa_raw e ON e.user_id=p.user_id AND e.product_id=p.product_id GROUP BY p.query_id,p.product_id

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE _hsa_strata AS SELECT s.*,m.candidate_category_missing category_missing,m.candidate_category_ambiguous category_ambiguous,(last_pair_view<? OR last_pair_purchase<?) old_recency_support FROM _hsa_support s JOIN _hsa_meta m USING(query_id,product_id)
